svg.title: Ad Monetization and Placement Measures
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-ad-monetization-measurement-architecture; chapter number: 11; title: Ad Monetization and Placement Measures; subtitle: Revenue controls from Casey Botticello ([uSKcihbY0hs @ 00:21:27]), Meghan's Media ([XXTUzO1Y_1U @ 00:03:53]), CanEye ([FyVNDOxiU6o @ 00:04:15]), and Carl Broadbent ([feVaD3YiPFE @ 00:08:53]).; chart type: org_architecture; note: This is an architecture of monetization measures, not a staffing chart; the digest supplies no team headcount. The spokes retain separate accounts and denominators. She Knows SEO ([xRuzXK8HIFo @ 00:06:05]) says results change significantly between sessions and page views. Meghan's Media ([NRcTFL8qghY @ 00:04:05]) recommends checking each placement's dollar contribution before removal.; center: role: Ad-monetized website [David Kowalski — OzPRqoG7brI @ 00:10:53]; headcount: Measures rather than personnel; no staffing count supplied; focus: Ads pay on traffic; affiliate pays on intent; products pay on trust. [David Kowalski — OzPRqoG7brI @ 00:10:53]; spokes: role: Revenue Share; type: Reported network term; kpi: Flat 75% revenue share in the speaker's account. [Casey Botticello — uSKcihbY0hs @ 00:21:27]; role: Raptive Monthly Earnings; type: Reported February account; kpi: $55.22 average RPM alongside 46,000 sessions and $2,568 earnings. [Meghan's Media — XXTUzO1Y_1U @ 00:03:53]; role: Journey Opening Period; type: Reported first 30 days; kpi: $16.15 RPM during the first 30 days. [CanEye — FyVNDOxiU6o @ 00:04:15]; role: Video-Ad Contribution; type: Reported placement earnings share; kpi: 8.3% of one website's displayed ad earnings. [Carl Broadbent — feVaD3YiPFE @ 00:08:53]
